items.title: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) beats Q3 CY2026 sales expectations, provides optimistic revenue guidance for next quarter
items.summary: Materials and photonics company Coherent (NYSE:COHR) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), with revenue up 49.9% year on year to $2.37 billion. In addition, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($2.65 billion at the midpoint) was stronger than expected, coming in 4.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.09 per share was 6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
